capabilities: Layout folders as a card wall gallery
Run git-annex operations via context menu
Track repository status in the status bar
extras: Desktop only (requires Node/Electron APIs); does not bundle git or git-annex binaries.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of visually browsing and managing large image assets stored and tracked exclusively by git-annex within a standard Markdown vault.

relations.evidence: The vault remains an ordinary git + git-annex repository.
External programs invoked: git, git-annex (through git annex), and ImageMagick 7 (magick, for thumbnails and image dimensions).

summary: Annex Gallery transforms git-annex managed image folders into a visual card wall gallery, generating thumbnails and sidecar metadata while maintaining repository integrity.
